data.title: 焰影苇草 · 窗边的晚安
data.description: 她把热饮交到你手中，指尖相碰时稍稍停了一瞬，随后轻声说，希望明晚也能这样见面。
data.action: 递出热饮，轻轻触碰镜头前的手
data.camera: 中近景，人物神态与互动清晰
data.promptProse: Standing by a rain-flecked window in the evening lounge, Reed gently extends a warm ceramic mug toward the viewer with both hands. A shaded amber table lamp illuminates her tender smile and the faint wisp of vapor rising between their meeting fingertips.
data.animaCaption: She offers the steaming mug with both hands, her fingers briefly brushing the viewer's as she softly murmurs a goodnight wish.
